non_compatibility_rule: This replacement does not keep VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer as a runtime fallback, does not keep the Vulkan indirect bindless array protocol, does not preserve globally stable Vulkan bindless handle semantics, and does not allow dual descriptor-buffer plus descriptor-heap execution paths.

design_constraints.title: Replacement only
design_constraints.detail: Descriptor heap must replace the current Vulkan descriptor buffer architecture instead of layering on top of it. Old execution paths must be deleted after the new path is complete.

design_constraints.title: No stable Vulkan bindless handles
design_constraints.detail: Vulkan bindless indices become snapshot-local online heap indices. The runtime must not emulate the old globally stable handle meaning through compatibility indirection.

design_constraints.title: Offline plus online split
design_constraints.detail: Long-lived descriptors must live in offline canonical storage first. Online heap storage is transient live shader-visible state.

design_constraints.title: Completion-driven reclamation
design_constraints.detail: Online heap reuse must be tied to GPU completion, submit retirement, or equivalent completion signaling, never frame-index reset alone.

design_constraints.title: PowerShell-only validation entrypoints
design_constraints.detail: Windows validation continues through existing PowerShell scripts under testscripts/. No new primary bash, batch, or Python wrapper may become the main validation path.

design_constraints.title: Descriptor-heap-native regular binding
design_constraints.detail: Regular binding must no longer depend on descriptor-buffer byte offsets, vkCmdBindDescriptorBuffersEXT, or vkCmdSetDescriptorBufferOffsetsEXT.

design_constraints.title: Direct heap shader access
design_constraints.detail: Vulkan shaders must access descriptors through ResourceDescriptorHeap and SamplerDescriptorHeap semantics rather than the current indirect array-buffer protocol.

runtime_capability_gap.detail: Descriptor-heap feature and property query, device enablement, runtime command validation, and startup capability surfacing are now wired. Remaining work moves to later checkpoints that actually consume this runtime capability for regular binding and bindless execution.

regular_binding_gap.detail: Pipeline layout and command recording are built around descriptor-buffer layout offsets and descriptor-buffer binding commands.

lifetime_gap.detail: The current global descriptor ring uses frame-sliced offsets and begin/end recording flow rather than retirement-driven online heap allocation and reclamation.

bindless_abi_gap.detail: Vulkan bindless still uses an indirect array buffer and packed handles instead of direct descriptor heap indexing.

image_descriptor_gap.detail: Image descriptor generation still relies on vkGetDescriptorEXT-era metadata and does not preserve enough view creation data for native descriptor-heap writes.

test_gap.detail: Existing PowerShell scripts already cover descriptor-heap capability parsing and validation blockers, and RHI tests now include concurrent online-range allocation coverage. They still do not cover descriptor-heap binding classes, direct bindless snapshots, or broader lifetime regressions.

checkpoints.title: Add Vulkan descriptor heap runtime capability
checkpoints.problem: The backend cannot execute descriptor-heap work because VK_EXT_descriptor_heap is not yet queried, enabled, or surfaced through the device layer.
progress_notes: Feature and property query wiring is already in place.
Device enablement is already wired into the Vulkan extension system.
Required descriptor-heap commands are now validated through vkGetDeviceProcAddr immediately after device creation.
Startup logs now report either descriptor-heap runtime availability or an explicit disabled reason before later stages consume the capability.
Supported runs still emit the existing descriptor-heap initialization marker so current PowerShell validation stays stable.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: The Vulkan backend queries descriptor heap features and properties.
Device creation can enable VK_EXT_descriptor_heap when supported.
Descriptor-heap-native commands are loaded and available to the backend.
Unsupported runtime environments fail or skip cleanly instead of silently falling back.
tasks: Add VkPhysicalDeviceDescriptorHeapFeaturesEXT and VkPhysicalDeviceDescriptorHeapPropertiesEXT query wiring.
Add VK_EXT_descriptor_heap device enablement to the Vulkan extension system.
Load vkCmdBindResourceHeapEXT, vkCmdBindSamplerHeapEXT, vkWriteResourceDescriptorsEXT, vkWriteSamplerDescriptorsEXT, and vkCmdPushDataEXT.
Expose descriptor-heap capability through the Vulkan device runtime so later stages can branch at startup rather than at bind time.
validation: Build TestRHITranslate through testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 and fail the checkpoint if Vulkan extension wiring does not compile.
Run the script on a machine with VK_EXT_descriptor_heap support and require the log to show descriptor-heap capability detection before any later descriptor-heap path is enabled.
Run the same script on a machine without VK_EXT_descriptor_heap support and require an explicit skip or startup-level disable message instead of silent fallback.

checkpoints.title: Cache image view creation metadata for native descriptor writes
checkpoints.problem: vkWriteResourceDescriptorsEXT for images needs create-info-level metadata that the current Vulkan texture view path does not preserve as the canonical write source.
progress_notes: Cached texture views now preserve VkImageViewCreateInfo alongside VkImageView.
A reusable helper now builds VkImageDescriptorInfoEXT and VkResourceDescriptorInfoEXT from TextureView plus layout.
The runtime still uses vkGetDescriptorEXT for the legacy path until later checkpoints switch binding transport to descriptor-heap-native writes.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Vulkan texture view storage preserves enough data to author native sampled-image and storage-image descriptor writes.
Image descriptor generation no longer depends on the old vkGetDescriptorEXT regular path for future descriptor-heap execution.
tasks: Store VkImageViewCreateInfo-equivalent metadata with Vulkan texture view state.
Add reusable accessors for native descriptor-heap image writes.
Remove assumptions that a cached VkImageView handle alone is enough to regenerate the image descriptor payload.
validation: Build TestRHITranslate through testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after every signature or helper change touching VulkanTexture or VulkanDescriptorHeap.

Add a descriptor-heap image write translation case that exercises sampled-image and storage-image metadata generation from the same TextureView with different layouts once CP-03 starts consuming the helper.
Require cubemap single-layer views, array slices, and non-zero mip base views to resolve through cached create-info rather than reconstructing from the image handle only.

checkpoints.title: Introduce offline canonical descriptor storage
checkpoints.problem: The current global descriptor storage is shaped for descriptor-buffer blob reuse, not for an offline canonical registry feeding online heap snapshots.
progress_notes: VulkanDescriptorHeap now owns explicit offline descriptor arenas for buffer, image, sampler, and acceleration-structure descriptors.
External Vulkan code no longer reads raw descriptor byte arrays directly; it consumes explicit offline copy helpers instead.

Bindless logical slots now cache offline resource descriptor offsets and sampler indices, but bindless uploads still duplicate payloads into the old descriptor-buffer-backed arrays and keep the indirect ABI alive.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Long-lived descriptors have one offline canonical storage owner.
Mutable CPU descriptor updates land in offline storage first.
Offline storage is cleanly separated from live online heap state.
tasks: Define persistent resource offline storage for image, buffer, sampler, and acceleration-structure descriptors.
Replace the old 'global descriptor ring as canonical source' assumption with offline descriptor ownership.
Make bindless logical slots resolve to offline entries rather than directly to online slots.
validation: Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 after changing descriptor ownership to ensure the legacy descriptor-buffer transport still reads from the new offline arenas correctly.
Require bindless descriptor memcpy call sites to go through offline-storage helpers instead of raw array access.
Reject any new code path that treats the transient ring descriptor buffer as the canonical CPU descriptor source.

checkpoints.title: Introduce online heap allocation and retirement-driven reuse
checkpoints.problem: The current frame-sliced ring buffer model does not satisfy descriptor-heap reserved-range rules or safe in-flight reuse.
progress_notes: Online descriptor reuse is already tied to submit retirement instead of frame index slicing.
The active ring recording state now lives in a heap-owned recording context with atomic concurrent range allocation.
Bindless ring caching is already consolidated into a heap-owned shared map keyed by bindless array plus descriptor version.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Online heap regions can be allocated for transient regular binding and shared bindless snapshots.
Online heap reuse happens only after GPU completion.
Reserved-range tracking is explicit and valid for resource and sampler heaps.
tasks: Add online resource heap allocation pages or chunks.
Add online sampler heap allocation pages or chunks.
Track online heap allocations through submit completion or equivalent retirement signals.
Delete frame-index-only reuse assumptions from the descriptor runtime.
Allow multiple command lists to reserve ring ranges concurrently from the same active heap recording context.
Use a heap-owned bindless cache map so same-version bindless arrays share one copied ring snapshot per recording.
validation: Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 and require TestRHITranslate to pass a concurrent online-range allocation case without overlap.
Run testscripts/test_all.ps1 and require the aggregate Vulkan runtime path to stay green after moving bindless ring caching into heap-owned shared state.
Reject any implementation that still depends on thread_local descriptor offsets or thread_local bindless cache maps for recording correctness.

checkpoints.title: Replace regular binding with descriptor-heap-native mapping
checkpoints.problem: Regular Vulkan binding still depends on descriptor-buffer set layouts, byte offsets, and descriptor-buffer binding commands.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Regular binding no longer uses vkCmdBindDescriptorBuffersEXT or vkCmdSetDescriptorBufferOffsetsEXT.
Pipeline reflection and runtime binding transport are descriptor-heap-native.
Regular bound parameters are copied from offline storage into online heap regions and mapped through push data.
tasks: Retool Vulkan pipeline layout creation for descriptor heap shader mapping.
Remove descriptor-buffer offset transport from VulkanPipelineParamBinder.
Bind resource and sampler heaps through vkCmdBindResourceHeapEXT and vkCmdBindSamplerHeapEXT.
Emit vkCmdPushDataEXT using VkShaderDescriptorSetAndBindingMappingInfoEXT-based mapping.

checkpoints.title: Replace Vulkan bindless ABI with direct heap indexing
checkpoints.problem: The Vulkan bindless path still uses an indirect array buffer and packed handles instead of direct ResourceDescriptorHeap and SamplerDescriptorHeap access.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: Vulkan bindless no longer relies on the indirect array-buffer protocol.
Vulkan shaders access bindless descriptors through direct heap semantics.
CPU-side uploads carry snapshot-local online indices rather than old stable logical handles.
tasks: Delete the Vulkan indirect bindless handle protocol from VulkanBindlessArray.
Build bindless online snapshots from referenced offline entries.
Update shader-side bindless macros to direct heap access.
Update CPU-side bindless consumers in scene, material, GPU scene, and draw payload code to accept snapshot-local remap behavior.

checkpoints.title: Add descriptor-heap validation behavior to PowerShell scripts
checkpoints.problem: The current PowerShell RHI test path does not yet expose capability detection, descriptor-heap-specific skip behavior, or validation parsing suitable for the new runtime path.
progress_notes: The shared PowerShell test library now supports top-level pass, fail, and skip plus grouped subtest reporting.
RHI test scripts now parse descriptor-heap capability state from runtime logs and treat Vulkan validation errors as blockers.
Latest aggregate test runs already report descriptor-heap capability and validation blockers as grouped subtests in summary.txt.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: PowerShell scripts can report pass, fail, and skip for descriptor-heap coverage.
RHI log parsing can surface Vulkan validation errors as blockers.
Descriptor-heap-only tests can skip cleanly on unsupported machines.
tasks: Extend testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 to print descriptor-heap capability state and grouped subtest results.
Extend testscripts/common.ps1 with standardized validation parsing and skip helpers.
Update testscripts/test_all.ps1 to include descriptor-heap summary output without creating a new primary entrypoint.
validation: Run testscripts/test_rhi_translate.ps1 and require summary.txt to show both top-level and subtest counts with PASSED, FAILED, and SKIPPED states.
Run testscripts/test_all.ps1 and require Vulkan validation blockers to fail the aggregate result even when process exit codes are zero.
Keep all validation entrypoints in existing PowerShell scripts only.

checkpoints.title: Add descriptor-heap binding coverage to RHI tests
checkpoints.problem: The existing RHI tests do not validate the new descriptor-heap binding path across descriptor classes, graphics and compute stages, bindless snapshots, or in-flight lifetime hazards.
progress_notes: RHI tests already include a concurrent online-range allocation case that exercises the heap-owned recording allocator.
Coverage still does not exercise regular descriptor binding classes, direct bindless snapshots, or pre-completion reuse hazards across real queue submissions.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: RHI tests cover all regular descriptor binding classes required by the replacement path.
RHI tests cover direct bindless snapshot behavior and snapshot-local index correctness.
RHI tests cover online heap lifetime, non-overlap, and retirement-driven reuse behavior.
tasks: Add regular binding tests for uniform buffer, storage buffer, texel buffer, sampled image, storage image, sampler-only, acceleration structure, descriptor arrays, and mixed set layouts.
Add graphics-path and compute-path coverage where the descriptor type is valid for each stage.
Add bindless tests for texture, sampler, storage buffer, mixed texture-plus-sampler, and multiple in-flight snapshots.
Add lifetime tests that prove online heap regions are not reused before GPU completion and that mixed regular plus bindless use remains correct.

checkpoints.title: Delete the old descriptor-buffer and indirect-bindless path
checkpoints.problem: Keeping both descriptor-buffer and descriptor-heap execution paths would preserve the exact dual-track complexity this replacement is meant to remove.
what_must_be_true_after_this_checkpoint: The Vulkan backend exposes one descriptor path only.
Descriptor-buffer-specific binding commands, layout assumptions, and helper state are removed.
The old indirect bindless array-buffer protocol is removed.
tasks: Delete descriptor-buffer-specific pipeline flags and layout flags from the runtime path.
Delete vkCmdBindDescriptorBuffersEXT and vkCmdSetDescriptorBufferOffsetsEXT main-path recording code.
Delete the old Vulkan indirect bindless array protocol and any dead helper state left behind.
Delete old regular-binding descriptor blob generation paths that only exist for descriptor buffer execution.

execution_order: CP-01: add descriptor-heap runtime capability before deleting anything from the current path.
CP-02: cache image view creation metadata early because native descriptor writes depend on it.
CP-03: establish offline canonical descriptor storage as the long-lived source of truth.
CP-04: build online heap allocation and retirement-driven reuse for live shader-visible state.
CP-05: replace regular binding with descriptor-heap-native mapping and push-data transport.
CP-06: replace Vulkan bindless ABI with direct heap indexing and snapshot-local indices.
CP-07: extend PowerShell scripts so descriptor-heap capability and validation behavior are test-visible.
CP-08: add runtime coverage for all descriptor-heap binding classes and lifetime hazards.
CP-09: delete the old descriptor-buffer and indirect-bindless path once the new path is proven.

requirements: Do not introduce a new primary non-PowerShell validation entrypoint.
Descriptor-heap-only tests must support explicit skip with a clear reason when unsupported.
Logs must continue to be captured into the existing logs/run_* output convention.
RHI validation parsing must surface Vulkan validation errors as blockers instead of relying only on process exit code.
Warnings and info remain non-blocking unless explicitly promoted.
Result reporting must distinguish pass, fail, and skip for descriptor-heap subtests.

test_descriptions.name: Descriptor heap capability probe
test_descriptions.description: At startup, report whether VK_EXT_descriptor_heap is supported, enabled, or skipped on the current machine before running any descriptor-heap-specific assertions.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: The log contains one clear capability line and the script summary records pass or skip explicitly.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: VK_EXT_descriptor_heap is unavailable or required feature bits are missing.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: The runtime silently falls back, capability state is missing, or the script cannot distinguish unsupported from failed.

test_descriptions.name: Image descriptor metadata coverage
test_descriptions.description: Exercise sampled-image and storage-image descriptor generation for the same TextureView, plus cubemap single-layer downgrade, array slice, and non-zero mip-range views.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: All tested subresource views produce deterministic descriptor metadata and no Vulkan validation errors appear in the log.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: Descriptor-heap image write path is not enabled on the current backend yet.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: The descriptor path rebuilds metadata from image handle alone, uses the wrong layout or view type, or emits validation errors.

test_descriptions.name: Regular binding class matrix
test_descriptions.description: Cover uniform buffer, storage buffer, uniform texel buffer, storage texel buffer, sampled image, storage image, sampler-only, acceleration structure, descriptor arrays, and mixed layouts across graphics and compute where valid.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: Every descriptor class required by the new mapping path is exercised and the summary reports each subtest independently.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: A stage-specific case is unsupported by the underlying device feature set.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: Any descriptor class is untested, mapped through the old descriptor-buffer offset path, or produces validation failures.

test_descriptions.name: Direct bindless snapshot coverage
test_descriptions.description: Validate texture, sampler, storage-buffer, and mixed texture-plus-sampler bindless snapshots, including multiple in-flight snapshots with snapshot-local index remapping.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: Snapshot-local online indices resolve correctly for all in-flight snapshots without relying on globally stable Vulkan handles.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: Descriptor-heap bindless path is not enabled yet.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: Old indirect bindless array semantics remain observable or multiple snapshots alias the same online heap region incorrectly.

test_descriptions.name: Retirement-driven reuse hazard test
test_descriptions.description: Submit multiple command lists that intentionally hold online heap regions in flight while later submissions allocate more descriptors, then verify reuse waits for completion.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: No online heap region is reused before the owning submission retires, and validation stays clean.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: Descriptor-heap online allocator is not enabled yet.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: Frame-index reset or non-retired reuse causes aliasing, corruption, or validation errors.

test_descriptions.name: Summary and validation blocker behavior
test_descriptions.description: Require the aggregate script to preserve pass, fail, and skip counts for descriptor-heap subtests and treat Vulkan validation errors as blockers even if the executable exits with code 0.
test_descriptions.pass_condition: The shared summary clearly separates pass, fail, and skip, and validation errors flip the aggregate result to failure.
test_descriptions.skip_condition: All descriptor-heap subtests are unsupported on the current machine.
test_descriptions.failure_condition: Validation errors are logged but ignored, or the aggregate summary collapses skip into pass/fail only.

acceptance_criteria: The Vulkan backend enables and uses VK_EXT_descriptor_heap instead of VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer.
Regular Vulkan binding no longer depends on descriptor-buffer offsets or descriptor-buffer bind commands.
Offline canonical descriptor storage feeds online heap allocations and snapshots.
Online heap reuse is gated by GPU completion, not frame reset.
Vulkan bindless uses direct descriptor heap indexing and snapshot-local indices.
Image descriptor writes no longer depend on the old vkGetDescriptorEXT regular path.
PowerShell scripts report pass, fail, and skip for descriptor-heap coverage.
RHI tests cover all required descriptor-heap regular bindings, bindless behavior, and lifetime hazards.
The old descriptor-buffer and indirect-bindless path is deleted.

biggest_risks.title: Deleting old descriptor-buffer transport too early
biggest_risks.impact: The Vulkan backend would lose all regular binding before descriptor-heap runtime plumbing and mapping are ready.
biggest_risks.mitigation: Do not perform destructive cleanup before CP-05 and CP-08 are complete.

biggest_risks.title: Keeping stable bindless handle semantics by stealth
biggest_risks.impact: A hidden compatibility indirection would preserve old complexity and block a clean direct heap model.
biggest_risks.mitigation: Make snapshot-local remap an explicit design rule and reject runtime compatibility translation layers.

biggest_risks.title: Online heap reuse before retirement
biggest_risks.impact: In-flight descriptors could be overwritten by a later submit, producing silent correctness bugs.
biggest_risks.mitigation: Tie online heap reuse to completion events and add explicit retirement tests before cleanup.

biggest_risks.title: Image descriptor metadata still being incomplete
biggest_risks.impact: vkWriteResourceDescriptorsEXT image writes would be blocked or would require falling back to the old path.
biggest_risks.mitigation: Treat image-view create-info caching as an early hard prerequisite, not a late optimization.

biggest_risks.title: Scripts not surfacing validation failures
biggest_risks.impact: Descriptor-heap regressions could pass the executable exit-code path while still violating Vulkan validation.
biggest_risks.mitigation: Add validation parsing and grouped descriptor-heap reporting to the existing PowerShell scripts.
